method.headline: Three things, every week, consistently.
method.intro: No crash diet and no two hours a day in the gym. Three components that reinforce each other and that hold up alongside a job and a family.

faq.headline: What people usually want to know.
faq.contactLine: Question not covered? Email me at

gym.q: Do I need a gym membership?
gym.a: Depending on your goals, a gym membership is not always necessary. It can definitely help accelerate progress and give you access to more equipment, but many results can also be achieved with smart home workouts or bodyweight training. We'll tailor the approach to what works best for you.

firstWeek.q: What happens in the first week?
firstWeek.a: After the intro call you get your starter plan within 48 hours: your first week of training, a short guide to food logging, and a slot booked for the first check-in. One step at a time.

beginner.q: Is this suitable if I've never trained before?
beginner.a: Yes. Most people who start with me have little or no strength training experience. We begin where you are and build at your pace.

time.q: How much time does it take per week?
time.a: This depends on your specific goals. If your main focus is losing weight, a few minutes a day can already make a meaningful difference. If building muscle is also part of the plan, expect training sessions of roughly 30–60 minutes. We'll design a schedule that fits realistically into your life.

travel.q: Does this work if I travel a lot?
travel.a: Yes. Online and hybrid are built for it. Sessions adapt to a hotel gym or a hotel room, food logging works anywhere, and the check-in happens over video or message.

notSure.a: Book an intro call and decide afterwards. It's free and there's no obligation. If I'm not the right person for you, I'll say so, and point you somewhere better.
